CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA: DREXIT -- a door that is also a level exit, first class in the SHANKPIT level editor (Selected Cube inspector: one button attaches a door to the wall and a level exit at that same position). Also fixed a pre-existing goldenband.ts tsc build break that was silently blocking all NOCK frontend builds. (sess-20260920-1908-24cb3558)
